name: Vanta
description: Vanta is a compliance and trust automation platform that continuously monitors security controls, automates evidence collection, and helps organizations earn and maintain certifications such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR.
best_for: Security and compliance teams wanting continuous, integration-based control monitoring across many frameworks alongside a public-facing trust center.
features: Continuous compliance monitoring across more than 35 frameworks, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO 42001
Automated evidence collection by pulling data from more than 400 connected tools
AI agent that drafts security-questionnaire responses and policies
Trust Center for publishing real-time security posture to prospects and customers
Centralized risk register and personnel/access-review management
pros: Broad framework coverage (35+) with automated evidence collection from 400+ integrated tools
Public Trust Center for real-time posture sharing
Vanta itself holds a SOC 2 Type II attestation and an ISO 27001 certification, per its own security page
cons: No public pricing on any of its four tiers — every plan requires contacting sales for a quote
Vanta automates compliance monitoring but does not itself issue the SOC 2 report or ISO certificate — that still requires an independent third-party auditor/certification body

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.notes: Vanta's entry package, described on its pricing page as "the fastest, simplest path to compliance." No public price listed; contact sales for a quote.

tiers.name: Plus
tiers.notes: Marked "Most popular" on Vanta's pricing page and described as "a strong compliance foundation plus security." No public price listed.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Described on Vanta's pricing page as "compliance, risk, and reporting all in one package." No public price listed.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Described on Vanta's pricing page as "a trust program tailored to your unique needs." Contact sales.

alternatives.name: Drata
alternatives.description: A compliance automation platform for continuous control monitoring and evidence collection across frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR.
alternatives.best_for: Compliance and security teams comparing agentic, AI-assisted compliance automation platforms alongside Vanta.
strengths: AI agent governance module for monitoring AI agents
Trust Center built into the core platform

faq.question: Is Vanta itself SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certified?
faq.answer: That is a separate claim from Vanta helping customers earn their own certifications. Vanta's own security page states that Vanta "maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation and an ISO 27001 compliance certification" for its own organization.
